scope: Independent read-only source-level audit of OLP-0201..OLP-0300 against the pinned English source, frozen MSA baseline, Classical Arabic style specification, batch receipts, formal-errata audit, and terminology contract. No source, batch receipt, TeX, Git, network, or publication mutation was performed.

method.reading: All prose-bearing units were read in English and Classical Arabic in full, with the frozen MSA witness consulted for provenance and ambiguity. Definitions, hypotheses, polarity, negation, quantifier scope, formula and cross-reference integrity, proof steps, examples, exercises, and Arabic discourse flow were checked. Structural units were compared in all three witnesses.
method.style_assessment: All 94 prose-bearing targets are materially rephrased and broadly form a coherent Classical-Arabic-leaning scholarly register; none is a hidden byte-identical MSA copy. Seven localized defects originate in the new overlay wording and prevent final acceptance until repaired.
method.receipt_policy: Batch statements were treated as leads rather than semantic proof. Receipt-declared unresolved issues were independently checked; several are confirmed here.
method.formal_errata_policy: The formal-errata artifact ends at OLP-0100 and therefore supplies no in-range clearance or finding.
limitations: Source-level review only; no TeX engine, PDF render, typography, or bidirectional-layout validation was run.
No proof assistant checked the mathematics; formal findings are reasoned source audits.
PASS means no defect was found in this bounded full read, not a proof that none exists.
No network or external terminology authority was consulted.

completeness.explicit_note: No unit is unreviewed. The five listed findings remain probable or uncertain for the reasons recorded in each finding; all other findings are high-confidence source observations.

static_validation.interpretation: Exit 2 reflects incomplete semantic/terminology certification, not a byte or invariant failure. Static validation does not prove translation fidelity.

terminology_coverage.assessment: The retrospective ledger marks every in-range unit pending and contains no actual translation decision or authority check. It therefore does not satisfy the requested complete rationale-and-expert-review log.

process_finding.required_fix: Populate occurrence-level decision records for all review-worthy terms in these 100 units: source and chosen Arabic, exact unit/line/occurrence, alternatives, contextual rationale, authority status, confidence, and open-to-correction flag. findings.issue: The Classical sentence coordinates «فإذا كانت ...، وأن ... . فالترميز»; the second conjunct is not governed by the conditional and the apodosis is stranded.

replacements.replace_ar: وأن الترميزين المسندين إلى $f$ و~$g$ هما $F$ و~$G$ على الترتيب.
replacements.with_ar: وكان الترميزان المسندان إلى $f$ و~$g$ هما $F$ و~$G$ على الترتيب،

findings.issue: The construction chooses the largest prime p_n≤x. Such a prime does not exist for x=0 or x=1, although the proof is stated for every natural x.

required_fix.replacement_ar: أما إذا كان x<2 فتعالج الحالتان مباشرةً؛ ولنفرض فيما بقي أن x≥2، ثم ليكن p_n أكبر عدد أولي لا يتجاوز x.

findings.issue: The universal condition on entries of t is nested inside the universal condition on entries of s. When s is empty, the t-condition becomes vacuous, so the displayed predicate does not characterize concatenation.
«وطريقة ... هو الآتي» makes the feminine head noun طريقة agree with masculine هو/الآتي.

required_fix.replace_ar: وطريقة حساب $\mu x\;f(x,\vec z)$ هو الآتي:
required_fix.with_ar: وطريقة حساب $\mu x\;f(x,\vec z)$ هي الآتية:

findings.issue: The preceding enumeration defines φ_e for every natural e, yet the diagonal definition and proof include a branch in which e is not an index of a partial recursive function. That branch is impossible under the chapter's own convention and obscures the diagonal equivalence.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Remove the non-index disjunct/branch. Define h(e,x)=0 exactly when φ_e(x) is undefined (and leave it undefined otherwise), then run the diagonal argument using that definition.

findings.issue: English and MSA introduce a standing choice/assumption from this point onward. «ونثبت فيما يأتي اختيارًا» says that a choice will be proved later, changing both the speech act and the logical dependency.

«الدالة U(s)، التي تعين متتالية حساب رمزها s إلى النتيجة» has a broken argument/complement structure and does not clearly say that U extracts the final result from the computation sequence coded by s.

required_fix.replace_ar: الدالة $U(s)$، التي تعين متتالية حساب رمزها~$s$ إلى النتيجة النهائية لذلك الحساب
required_fix.with_ar: الدالة $U(s)$، التي تستخرج من متتالية الحساب ذات الرمز~$s$ النتيجة النهائية لذلك الحساب

findings.issue: The statement calls e,a_0,… a single sequence, although e is an index/number and all listed objects are natural-number arguments.
The \iftag{TMs} occurrence supplies only two arguments although the project macro takes three. The next token can therefore be consumed as the missing argument and corrupt expansion.
«تطلب ... سجل ... أو عن حساب» combines a direct object with an عن-complement under one verb.

required_fix.replacement_ar: فالدالة~$h$ تبحث عند الدخل~$x$ عن سجل حساب متوقف لـ~$\cfind{d}$ أو عن سجل حساب متوقف لـ~$\cfind{e}$.

findings.issue: The proposed reduction g(w)=s(e,(w)_0,(w)_1) is applied to every natural w, but K_0 contains only valid pair codes. On an invalid pair code the projection behavior is unconstrained and g(w) may enter K_1, so the biconditional required for the many-one reduction is not established.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Choose a fixed index z∉K_1 (for example an index of the nowhere-defined unary function) and define g(w)=s(e,(w)_0,(w)_1) when len(w)=2, and g(w)=z otherwise.

findings.issue: The exercise says the mover is composed with the corrected doubler diagram, but the construction described earlier explicitly composes the original doubler from ex:doubler with the mover.

The decoder stops at the first represented blank and erases what follows. A code containing an internal blank followed by a nonblank symbol is therefore accepted as a prefix natural even though it is not a canonical unary input.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: After the first represented blank, scan every remaining represented cell and accept only if each is blank; if any later cell is nonblank, diverge or leave a deliberately non-unary output.

findings.issue: Both displayed next-configuration formulas require the old symbol to remain at every represented square, including the scanned square m, while the prose simultaneously says that m is overwritten. The conjunction is inconsistent whenever the written symbol differs.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: In both move cases quantify preservation only over i≠m, e.g. ∀i<... (i≠m → (old-symbol-at-i ↔ new-symbol-at-i)), and state the new symbol at m separately.

findings.issue: The far-left-square branch uses unrelated q_i and q_j although the surrounding case fixed the current instruction as q,a↦q′,b,L. The formula therefore is not tied to the transition under discussion.
Machine E is said to halt on the far-left square/endmarker, but E concatenated with D enters D there while D's input convention starts on square 1. No repositioning transition is supplied.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Either specify that E halts on square 1 (the first square after the endmarker) before control passes to D, or insert an explicit one-square-right repositioning machine between E and D.

findings.issue: The text claims T′ entails C(n)∧B(n) for every n, including n=0. The transition axioms supply B(y′) only for successors, and the number axioms shown do not rule out elements below 0, so B(0) is not derived by the stated argument.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Keep C(n) for every n, but state and use B(n) only for n>0; update the exercise wording to the same restriction.

findings.issue: The corollary literally excludes any sound and complete derivation system for finite validity. The computability contradiction requires the proofs/derivations to be effectively enumerable (or proof checking decidable), which is not stated.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Qualify the forbidden system as effective: add «فعّال» and state that its derivations are effectively enumerable, equivalently that finite proofs have decidable checking.

findings.uncertainty: The intended textbook convention may silently build effectiveness into «نظام اشتقاق», but the displayed statement does not say so.

findings.issue: The macro !!{represents} expands to a finite verb, producing the ungrammatical «ولتكن تمثّل».
The Classical prose contains the doubled predicate «تحقق تصدق» and the misspelling «المرّمزة».
The displayed Sent predicate only checks absence of free occurrences under an informal assumption that x already codes a formula, yet the proposition claims an exact iff for arbitrary x.

The displayed Sequent and Deriv characterizations rely on tuple/sequence/tree projections without explicit well-formed code guards, then claim exact iff statements for arbitrary naturals. Together with the defective Sent predicate in OLP-0284, junk codes may satisfy the formulas.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Conjoin an explicit primitive-recursive SeqCode guard in Sequent, a TreeCode/derivation-tree guard in Deriv, and use the corrected Sent predicate before asserting each iff.

findings.uncertainty: Some coding libraries totalize projections with hidden canonicality conditions; those conditions were not present in the displayed definitions reviewed here.

findings.issue: The explanation of p_1 says that after arity 1 comes the conclusion code, omitting the actual immediate-subderivation field p_0 present in the displayed tuple.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Enumerate the tuple fields explicitly in order as 1, p_0, EndSeq, 9, and identify p_0 as the immediate subderivation code.

findings.issue: OpenAssum treats label 0 like an ordinary discharge label. Because undischarged assumptions and non-discharging rules also use 0, any ancestor carrying 0 can make an undischarged assumption appear discharged.

Subseq is defined here merely by membership, not by preservation of order, so it does not encode an ancestor path. The bound s≤SubtreeSeq(d) is also unsupported for arbitrary sequence coding and can omit valid reordered codes.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Introduce an explicit bounded path-sequence predicate that preserves parent/child order from the assumption node to d, and bound its code with a proved sequenceBound(...) large enough for every such path.

findings.uncertainty: A stronger imported definition could repair part of this, but the local prose explicitly describes only membership.

findings.issue: The proposition says x codes a derivation of A from Γ, but the definition interprets x as a closed proof of an existentially selected nested conditional. Thus x no longer carries the Γ-derivation witness claimed by the prose.

required_fix.replacement_instruction: Either rewrite the proposition to say exactly that x codes a closed proof of the existentially chosen nested conditional, or encode a pair ⟨d,s⟩ where d is the closed transformed derivation and s records the Γ-proof witness so x actually codes the asserted relation.

findings.issue: The lemma declares a generic A but displays A_f, and the later shorthand drops the formula marker and the numeral wrapper on (s)_1. The notation does not denote the stated represented instance consistently.

The inserted phrase «لكل رتبة ملائمة» quantifies over a 'rank/arity' even though the construction needs one witness equation for each component function g_i. It can misstate which objects are universally covered.
findings.uncertainty: The formulas nearby make the intended index range recoverable, but the Arabic noun is not a faithful statement of it.

findings.issue: The proof jumps from the metalanguage fact g(k,n)≠0 directly to Q⊢¬A_g(k,n,0) without naming the uniqueness clause of functional representation together with Q's proof that the two distinct numerals are unequal.

required_fix.replacement_ar: وبحسب بند الوحدانية في تمثيل الدالة، ومع كون Q يثبت عدم تساوي العددين المرمَّزين المختلفين (بالرجوع إلى q-proves-neq)، ينتج Q⊢¬A_g(k,n,0).

findings.issue: This file uses \olfileid{inc}{inp}{s1c}, whereas neighboring units in the same representability-in-q chapter use the inc/req namespace and no external s1c reference was found in the bounded repository search.
findings.uncertainty: The identifier may be a deliberate historical namespace; the bounded source comparison does not prove it is a typo.

provisional_expert_questions.rationale: Three unrelated Arabic families are used for one central technical notion, impairing cross-chapter coherence.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Which authority-backed lemma and genitive phrase should be the book-wide canonical rendering?

provisional_expert_questions.rationale: Both are intelligible, but two labels for the same formal operation hinder retrieval and definition reuse.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Which term should be canonical in Arabic mathematical logic, and is the other needed for a distinct operation?

provisional_expert_questions.english: arity / index / quantifier rank / enumeration position
provisional_expert_questions.current: رتبة is used across several distinct notions
provisional_expert_questions.provisional_preference: عدد الحجج/المواضع for arity; الفهرس/الموضع for sequence position; رتبة الكم for quantifier rank
provisional_expert_questions.rationale: Unqualified رتبة risks collapsing formal arity, order/rank, and an index.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Please establish a coordinated, non-overloaded vocabulary for these four notions.

provisional_expert_questions.rationale: كاذبة means false/deceptive and introduces an unintended evaluation absent from the English technical term.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Which term is attested in Arabic computer-science standards?

provisional_expert_questions.english: computably enumerable / semidecidable / many-one reduction / index set / characteristic predicate or function
provisional_expert_questions.rationale: This linked vocabulary should be validated as a system so one repair does not create a new inconsistency.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Which forms are standard in official Arabic computability dictionaries, including the predicate/function distinction?

provisional_expert_questions.rationale: The current forms are morphologically marked and do not stably expose the crucial effectiveness distinction.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: What canonical terms distinguish having axioms, admitting axiomatization, and effective axiomatizability?

provisional_expert_questions.rationale: مميز is understandable but does not itself communicate the proof-rule freshness condition.
provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: What term is established in Arabic proof theory, and should the first occurrence include the freshness gloss?

provisional_expert_questions.expert_question: Is this contrast accepted in Arabic proof-theory usage?
